Maya_CS: Heads-up — just finished a 1:1 with Meridian Health. They surfaced a handful of product asks from onboarding + early usage that could affect renewal if we don't address them. Can we quick-prioritize?

Jonah_PM: Thanks — can you list the asks? high-level is fine.

Maya_CS: Sure, raw notes: 1) Confusing billing attribution for per-route embeddings (they can't map cost to teams) 2) Onboarding docs missing an examples guide for Dedicated vs Hosted 3) Sporadic latency spikes on long chat sessions (seen on liveness tests) 4) Need a simple UI to bulk-approve model rollouts for their security committee.

Sam_Eng: Re: latency spikes — do we have traces or sample request IDs? that helps narrow whether it's KV cache eviction vs scheduling.

Maya_CS: I asked for logs, they said they saw spikes during long sessions ~10–15k tokens. Will push a request to support and paste here when available. ProdBot created ticket #CH-7821.

ProdBot: Ticket CH-7821 created by Maya_CS: "Meridian — onboarding + cost attribution + latency". Link: https://redwood/tickets/CH-7821

Tina_CSE: For billing attribution: we can offer a short-term CSV export that maps requests -> route -> team. Long-term we'd want per-route line items in billing UI. Quick question: are they on Dedicated or Hosted?

Maya_CS: Hosted with a trial dedicated pool for a single team. They want per-team cost breakdown to present to Finance. Renewal likely in 6 weeks; risk = medium-high if they can't show ROI.

Jonah_PM: Prioritization proposal: P0: billing export + docs snippet for Hosted/Dedicated decision matrix (customer-facing) P1: gather latency traces and triage P2: UI for rollout approvals (needs PM/Legal). Thoughts?

Sam_Eng: Agree on P0 for export — should be straightforward (query usage logs). I can scope a small lambda to emit CSV within 3 business days. P1 depends on logs; if we get KV/cache evidence, mitigation could be simple (increase cache TTL) or scheduling tweak.

Tina_CSE: I'll prepare a 1-pager for them that explains the Hosted vs Dedicated tradeoffs, plus a template ROI calc they can show Finance. Can have a draft by EOD tomorrow.

Maya_CS: Awesome. Action items: Sam -> CSV export task + ETA; Tina -> docs + ROI template; Jonah -> scope UI ask with Legal and add to roadmap if warranted. I'll follow up with Meridian and share any logs into CH-7821.

Jonah_PM: I'll add a placeholder roadmap ticket and link CH-7821. If renewal risk increases, ask for AE involvement.

Sam_Eng: I'll start the export today and post progress here.

Maya_CS: Thanks team :heart: will ping after I get logs.

ProdBot: CH-7821 updated: Sam_Eng assigned.
